title: Entry field contract -- money fields (one discriminated format variant)
description: What an entry-loop field must declare about itself, extracted from the single W-2 Box 1 field built and evaluated in the entry-loop-synthetic milestone (Track 3, repaired against the Track 3 review's F1). Source and destination make criterion 2.1 checkable against a declaration; purpose makes 2.2 checkable; correction names how an already-answered fact is located and changed. This schema does NOT yet cover any entry field: `format` is a discriminated union with exactly one member, `currency-amount` -- the positive-dollar-amount shape Track 2d built and both evaluation rounds exercised. A W-2 Box 13 checkbox, an employer name or EIN, a date, or a filing-status choice each need a format variant this milestone has no evidence for and does not invent; add a variant to the union (keyed by `kind`) only when a field of that shape is built, per the same reasoning the owner already applied to deferring the presentation role/context model until a second surface exists. The `source`/`destination`/`purpose`/`correction` core is offered as shared across fact families, but is itself evidenced by exactly one field -- see the milestone record's residual uncertainty. This schema is not wired into the kernel SchemaRegistry and validates no runtime act, fact, or finding -- it models the shape an entry surface's own field declaration takes, the same way citation.v1 models a citation without itself being a kernel citizen. Whether this should become a ratified ADR and a first-class citizen is an open recommendation, not decided here.

source.description: The document a person is holding and the exact box or line on it (criterion 2.1). 'label' is the box's own printed name, distinct from its identifier, so a field can name both 'Box 1' and 'Wages, tips, other compensation' without concatenating them into one string a renderer must parse back apart.

destination.description: The return line the value feeds.

format.description: A discriminated union keyed by 'kind'. Exactly one variant exists today: currency-amount. Adding a second variant (date, boolean, choice, identifier) is an addition to this union, not a breaking change to it -- and is only warranted once a field of that shape is actually built.

currency_amount_format.description: The Track 2d w2-box1-format.js shape, unchanged in behaviour and tagged with the 'kind' discriminator this repair adds. One declaration governs the hint a person reads, the validator that accepts or refuses, and the refusal message. This is a positive-dollar-amount format specifically; it is not a general numeric or text format.

correction.description: How an already-answered fact is located and changed without restarting the session. 'kind' is closed to its one observed member: W-2 Box 1's correction reuses the same field and input rather than opening a second view, which is the only correction shape this milestone built or observed. This is a provisional, not a designed-complete, enum -- extend it with a new member (a JSON Schema change, deliberately not a breaking one to existing declarations) the next time a field needs a shape this one doesn't cover, rather than widening it now on speculation.
